# Final results (generated by `scripts/final_analysis.py`)

All defect scores: 125 test cases, only complaints the court decided (found or rejected); "unargued" = defects flagged on points nobody argued (reported, not scored). **F1** counts a defect call as a hit whatever section it cites (detection); **strict F1** also requires the right section (a citation listing several sections counts if one is right). NoticeCheck takes its sections from a fixed table, so its two scores are equal.

## 0. Research questions against the criteria in the proposal

RQ1 (proposal): beat the same 8B model given the record alone on defect-level F1 *with type and cited provision matching*; falsified if the paired gain is under 10 points or its 95% CI includes 0, if our false-alarm rate exceeds the baseline's, or if we do not beat the rule checklist on reasoning-dependent defects.

| Criterion | Result | Met? |
|---|---|---|
| Strict F1 gain over B1 ≥ 0.10, CI above 0 | run 1 +0.23 [+0.11, +0.35]; run 2 +0.32 [+0.18, +0.44]; run 3 +0.28 [+0.14, +0.40] | Yes |
| False-alarm rate not above B1's (0.14) | NoticeCheck 0.22, 0.22, 0.30 | No |
| Beat B0 on reasoning-dependent defects | B0 – (no hits) vs NoticeCheck 0.34, 0.52, 0.44 | Yes |

Most of the strict gain over B1 comes from citing the right section (B1 cites a wrong one on 14 of its 27 hits; NoticeCheck never does). On detection alone (any section) the gain over B1 is +0.03 to +0.11 and not significant.

RQ2: the fine-tuned 8B extractor does not match the large model's drafts (field F1 0.80, 0.88 repaired, vs 0.95, which is inflated because reviewers corrected those drafts) but gains +0.28 over the untrained model (see section 8).

## 8. RQ2: fact extraction (test, 125 judgments)

QLoRA on Qwen3-8B (4-bit, rank 16): 196 training examples (Gemini drafts of other cases), 50 steps, 74 minutes on one T4; train loss 0.057, validation loss 0.037.

| Extractor | Field F1 | Precision | Recall | Events F1 | Doc contents F1 | Valid JSON | Schema-valid | Quotes found in judgment |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Untrained Qwen3-8B | 0.52 | 0.38 | 0.82 | 0.42 | 0.40 | 118/125 | 31/125 | 0.88 |
| Fine-tuned Qwen3-8B | 0.80 | 0.90 | 0.72 | 0.71 | 0.56 | 104/125 | 103/125 | 0.96 |
| Fine-tuned, cut-off outputs repaired | 0.88 | 0.91 | 0.84 | 0.72 | 0.55 | 125/125 | 103/125 | 0.96 |
| Gemini drafts (inflated: reviewers corrected these) | 0.95 | 0.96 | 0.94 | 0.96 | 0.97 | 125/125 | 125/125 | 0.97 |

Fine-tuned − untrained field F1: +0.282, 95% CI [+0.216, +0.339]. Held-out: untrained 0.50, fine-tuned 0.89.

Per field (F1): provision 0.64 → 0.71; financial_years 0.84 → 0.88; notice.date 0.76 → 0.86; notice.reply_due 0.07 → 0.40; notice.hearing_date_given 0.29 → 0.17; notice.hearing_date 0.35 → 0.22; notice.service_mode 0.20 → 0.82; notice.signed 0.03 → 0.00; notice.summary_only 0.05 → 0.67; order.date 0.88 → 0.87; order.signed 0.03 → 0.00; order.service_mode 0.09 → 0.48.

Defect calls on test: checked facts 84, fine-tuned extractor 70, untrained extractor 158. The untrained extractor filled in facts the judgment never states (hearing date given 77 cases, service mode 80, signature 57, of 125); 39% of its defect evidence quotes are not in the judgment (fine-tuned 24%, checked facts 18%, judgments cut at 12k characters).

## 10. Fresh-case hand check (20 new judgments, picked after the freeze; full system end to end)

81 calls checked by the team against the judgment (reviewers saw the system's answer; AI assistance declared by r1, r4).

| NoticeCheck said | Calls | Correct | Wrong | Can't verify |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| defect | 19 | 8 | 9 | 2 |
| contested | 16 | 10 | 4 | 2 |
| no defect | 46 | 33 | 2 | 11 |

- Defect calls: all 8 correct ones were defects the court found; all 6 defect calls on points nobody argued were judged wrong (0 correct). Human-judged defect precision 0.47.
- "No defect" right in 94% of verifiable calls; "contested" fits in 71%.
- Missed: about 14 court-found defects in 10 of 20 cases (mostly "no hearing" in the Madras portal-service template), so recall ≈ 0.36 (0.40 without the one case flagged out of scope). Consistent with the test set end to end (0.38).

## 11. Dataset

- Screened 20,087 GST judgments (24 High Courts, 2024–2026); 429 reasoned; 425 Gemini drafts.
- Gold: test 125, held-out 12 (Karnataka), dev 14 reviewed; fresh check 20.
- Test complaints: not_decided 66, defect_rejected 38, defect_found 104.
- Agreement: Cohen's κ 0.725 on 58 complaints in 35 double-reviewed cases (0.75 without the reviewer who used AI).
- Courts: Madras 52, Delhi 27, Allahabad 18, Karnataka 12, Bombay 10, Orissa 6, Calcutta 6, Patna 2, Jharkhand 2, Uttarakhand 1, Gauhati 1.
